Environment · India

India experiences varied monsoon impact, with some areas dry and others wet

India is experiencing a mixed monsoon season, with some regions facing a significant rainfall deficit, making it one of the driest Junes on record. Conversely, other areas, including Kolkata and parts of Uttar Pradesh and Himachal Pradesh, are receiving heavy rainfall and facing alerts for thunderstorms and potential flooding. The slow start to the monsoon has also impacted summer crop planting.
